ideas.pitch: An AI-powered matching and dispatch platform that connects Seattle-area community service nonprofits with vetted local volunteers based on real-time needs and geolocation.
ideas.title: Seattle Nonprofit Volunteer & Resource Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core mission of Seattle GiveCamp by providing an immediate, production-ready tool for local nonprofits to manage community outreach, aligning with past civic tech and social impact winners.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first macOS and web assistant designed for elderly residents of Seattle, leveraging local LLM capabilities to detect and flag fraudulent emails and phone scams in real time.
ideas.title: Senior Scam Shield Voice Agent for Local Outreach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a deeply felt community protection problem with tangible local impact, mirroring the technical approach of award-winning senior safety agents.

ideas.pitch: A localized multilingual AI chatbot providing health awareness, preventive care guidelines, and vaccination scheduling specifically tailored for semi-urban and immigrant populations in King County.
ideas.title: Community Health and Vaccine Schedule Multilingual Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on proven winning concepts for community health awareness, offering measurable social utility for local public health non-profits.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting dashboard for Seattle charitable organizations to predict spikes in community service demand (such as food bank usage or shelter needs) using regression models and local demographic data.
ideas.title: Civic Incident Forecaster for Regional Nonprofits
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced statistical forecasting to solve practical logistics problems for local charities, directly matching the scoring criteria of past forecasting hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI Chief of Staff agent customized for Seattle-area non-profit directors to automate grant writing, donor follow-up emails, and board meeting summary generation.
ideas.title: CivicFlow AI Operations Coordinator for Nonprofit Executives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the administrative overhead faced by every non-profit leader in the room, making the judges instantly recognize its practical utility.
